apps.name: What Can I Do?
apps.description: Point your camera at anything and your AI suggests things to make, cook, fix or play with it.
apps.prompt: A camera app: I point it at anything, take a photo and my AI suggests five ideas of what to do with it, with steps, and I can choose a focus like cooking, crafts, fixing or games for kids.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Stack Tower 3D
apps.description: Stack sliding blocks as high as you can: overhangs are cut off and tumble down, perfect drops grow your tower.
apps.prompt: A 3D stacking game with three.js: blocks slide in from alternating sides, I tap to drop them, the part that overhangs is cut and falls, perfect drops give combos and grow the block back, rainbow colours and a camera that rises with the tower.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Neon Drift 3D
apps.description: Race down a synthwave highway at sunset: drag to dodge neon barriers and grab glowing orbs.
apps.prompt: A 3D endless racer with three.js in a synthwave style: a neon grid highway, a striped sunset sun, wireframe mountains, a glowing car I steer by dragging, neon barriers to dodge, orbs to collect and speed that keeps rising.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Castle Siege 3D
apps.description: Defend your castle wall: enemies march up the valley towards you and you shoot them down with your crossbow.
apps.prompt: A 3D castle defence game with three.js where I stand on the castle wall looking down a valley, soldiers, goblins, knights, ogres and bosses march towards me along the road, I tap to shoot crossbow bolts, and between waves I buy upgrades like more damage, faster reload, multiple bolts, fire bolts and wall repairs.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Would You Rather
apps.description: Party, silly and deep dilemmas: everyone taps their choice and you reveal how the group split.
apps.prompt: A Would You Rather party game with three decks of questions, two big colourful halves to tap, a vote counter so the whole group can vote and a reveal with percentages.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Truth or Dare
apps.description: Add the players, pick a level from kids to bold, and let the phone choose truths and dares.
apps.prompt: A Truth or Dare game for groups: add players, choose kids, friends or bold level, it picks whose turn it is and shows a truth or a dare card, all fun and friendly.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Trivia Night
apps.description: Ten quick questions on geography, science, history, movies, sports or animals, with streaks and a 50:50.
apps.prompt: A trivia quiz with built-in questions in English and Spanish about geography, science, history, movies and music, sports and animals, ten questions per round with a 15 second timer, streak bonus, 50:50 and best score per topic.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Sudoku
apps.description: Endless Sudoku puzzles with one solution, four levels, notes, hints and undo.
apps.prompt: A Sudoku game that generates new puzzles with a single solution in four difficulty levels, with pencil notes, hints, undo, mistakes counter, timer and the game saved.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Story Adventure
apps.description: Your AI narrates an adventure where you choose what happens: fantasy, space, pirates and more.
apps.prompt: An interactive story game where my AI is the narrator: I choose a world like fantasy, space or pirates, name my hero, and each turn it writes the story with three choices or I type my own action, with health and inventory, saved to continue later.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Star Defender
apps.description: A neon space shooter: drag your ship, blast waves of enemies, collect upgrades and beat the bosses.
apps.prompt: A vertical space shooter with a ship I drag, auto fire, enemy types that zigzag, shoot or take many hits, waves, a boss every five waves, shield and weapon upgrades and a best score.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Solitaire
apps.description: Classic Klondike solitaire made for touch: tap a card and it jumps where it fits.
apps.prompt: Klondike solitaire for phones where tapping a card moves it to the best place, with draw one or draw three, undo, hints, auto-finish, a win animation and the game saved.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Sky Hopper
apps.description: Tap to flap a little bird through the pipes, earn medals and beat your best score.
apps.prompt: A Flappy Bird style game with a cute bird drawn in code, tap to flap, moving pipes later on, medals, sounds, parallax clouds and hills and a saved best score.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Neon Snake
apps.description: The classic snake in glowing neon: swipe to turn, eat the lights and chase bonus orbs.
apps.prompt: A neon snake game with swipe controls and arrow buttons, glowing food, pink bonus orbs that disappear, walls or wrap-around mode, three speeds and a saved best score.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Minesweeper
apps.description: Clear the field without hitting a mine: three sizes, long-press to flag and best times.
apps.prompt: A Minesweeper game made for touch: tap to dig, long-press or a flag mode to place flags, chording on numbers, three board sizes, a timer and best times per level.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Memory Match
apps.description: Flip the cards and find all the pairs: four board sizes, four themes and star ratings.
apps.prompt: A memory card game with 3D flipping cards, emoji themes like animals, food, sports and space, four board sizes, moves and time, star rating, confetti and best scores.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Magic 8 Ball
apps.description: Ask a yes or no question, shake or tap the ball and read your answer.
apps.prompt: A realistic Magic 8 Ball: type a question, shake the phone or tap the ball, it shakes and the blue triangle floats up with one of the twenty classic answers.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Hoop Shot 3D
apps.description: Swipe up to shoot hoops on a 3D court: real bounces off the rim, swishes, streaks and a moving hoop.
apps.prompt: A 3D basketball shooting game with three.js: swipe up to throw, ball physics that bounce off the rim and backboard, a wooden court and crowd lights, 60 seconds, extra points for swishes and streaks, and the hoop starts moving after 10 points.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Fortune Cookie
apps.description: Crack open a cookie for a fortune and your lucky numbers.
apps.prompt: A fortune cookie app: tap the cookie, it shakes and cracks in two halves, a paper with a funny or wise fortune and six lucky numbers appears, with crunch sound and share button.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Emoji Movies
apps.description: Guess the film from a few emoji, with hints and ten movies per round.
apps.prompt: A guess the movie from emoji quiz with forty famous films, four options, hints with the genre and year, ten movies per round and a best score.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Decision Wheel
apps.description: Can't decide? Make your own wheels, add options and spin with ticking sounds.
apps.prompt: A spinning decision wheel with colourful slices, ticking sound, several saved wheels I can name, editable options and an option to remove the winner after each spin.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Charades
apps.description: Guess the word on your forehead before time runs out: animals, movies, actions, jobs and more.
apps.prompt: A Heads Up style charades game: the phone shows a word from a deck like animals, movies or jobs, friends give clues, a 30, 60 or 90 second timer, got it and pass buttons and a results list.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Brick Breaker
apps.description: Smash neon bricks with a glowing paddle, catch power-ups and clear level after level.
apps.prompt: A brick breaker game with a paddle you drag, neon bricks in different patterns per level, bricks that need two hits, steel bricks, power-ups for a wider paddle, multi-ball, slow motion and extra lives.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Block Drop
apps.description: Classic falling blocks with a ghost piece, hold, next pieces and levels that speed up.
apps.prompt: A falling blocks puzzle game like Tetris with swipe and tap controls, ghost piece, hold, the next three pieces, levels that get faster and a saved best score.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.description: Swipe to slide the tiles and merge equal numbers until you reach 2048, with undo.
apps.prompt: The 2048 puzzle with smooth sliding tiles, swipe controls, undo, a best score and the game saved so I can continue later.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: 20 Questions
apps.description: Think of anything and your AI tries to guess it with yes or no questions.
apps.prompt: A 20 questions game where my AI asks me yes or no questions to guess what I'm thinking of, with categories like animals, famous people or food, and a score of AI against me.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Reef Aquarium
apps.description: A relaxing 3D reef: feed the fish and watch the jellyfish glow at night.
apps.prompt: A relaxing 3D aquarium: colorful fish swim in schools between swaying seaweed, coral and rocks, with rising bubbles and light rays from above. Tap the glass to drop food and the fish swim to eat it. Drag to rotate the camera.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Pocket Coach
apps.description: A workout coach that talks you through a 3-minute routine and vibrates on every change.
apps.prompt: A personal workout coach that talks: a 3-minute routine of exercises with a big animated countdown ring. The phone says each exercise out loud, counts down the last 3 seconds by voice, vibrates when switching and cheers you at the end. Energetic, modern design.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Pixel City
apps.description: Build an isometric pixel city with cars, people, a day and night cycle and fireworks.
apps.prompt: An isometric pixel art city builder: tap empty tiles to build houses, shops, parks and skyscrapers. Little cars drive on the roads and tiny people walk around. Money and population counters, and a day and night cycle where the windows light up at night. Cute and colorful.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Notes
apps.description: Notes with checklists, pinned notes, color labels and search.
apps.prompt: A professional notes app: write notes with a title and text, checklists, pin important notes, color labels and search, with a clean and elegant design.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Neon Kaleidoscope
apps.description: Draw with your finger and every stroke is mirrored eight ways in glowing neon.
apps.prompt: A neon kaleidoscope drawing app: draw with your finger and every stroke is mirrored in 8-way symmetry with glowing neon trails, sparkles and colors that slowly shift. Include an autoplay mode that draws by itself, and buttons to clear and change the symmetry.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Neon Drone Race
apps.description: A 3D race through glowing neon rings over a city at night, with rival drones.
apps.prompt: A 3D drone racing game: fly a drone through glowing neon rings over a futuristic city at night, with a lap timer, a boost button and an autopilot demo mode.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Piano
apps.description: Four instruments, multitouch keys and recordings you can play back.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Drummer
apps.description: Eight pads, a 16-step sequencer and saved beats.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Castle Defense
apps.description: Hold the castle against waves of enemies and bosses, with an upgrade shop.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Calculator
apps.description: A clean calculator with proper operator precedence and a saved history.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Bowling
apps.description: Swipe to throw, add hook spin and play a full game with real scoring.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: BMI
apps.description: Body mass index with a gauge, the healthy range and a progress chart.
apps.author: gonzaroman
